note: Round 4 (2026-10-10): candidates for the roles in SOUND_ROLE_GROUPS (packages/shared/src/sounds.ts) that had no take at all after wave A. Folder = role id, so a take's file says which role it was written for; the operator still places every take. Same prompt style as round 3: the physical source and action named literally, then recording descriptors. Interface sounds are tabletop and paper foley, short and dry, because they fire constantly. Colour and flavour gaps are NOT here: they wait for the operator's first assignment pass (docs/planning/audio.md).
negative: low quality, average quality, muffled, lo-fi, noise, hiss, distortion, clipping, music, melody, speech, voice, vocals, reverb wash
